name: Eutychus
bio: Eutychus, a young man at Troas, sat in a third-story window listening as Paul preached long into the night; overcome by sleep, he fell from the window and was taken up dead. Paul went down, embraced him, and declared that his life was still in him; after Paul continued preaching until daybreak, the believers brought Eutychus away alive, greatly comforted (Acts 20:9-12).
